Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device coupled to a subscriber terminal__.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription data specific to the subscriber's service tier or package__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __wherein the list is dynamically updated based on changes to the subscriber's subscription status__.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and storing the filtered EPG information in a local cache__.

Claim 6 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __at a scheduled interval or upon user request__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __in a graphical user interface on a display device__.

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on parental control settings or subscription tier information__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __via a secure communication protocol__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __from a local storage or remote server__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers.

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on a subscriber's display device in a customized layout based on subscriber preferences__.
